name: Ubadiyu
instructions: 1. Marinate vegetables in a spicy green paste. 2. Stuff into a clay pot lined with aromatic leaves. 3. Bury the pot upside down and cover with dry leaves. 4. Set fire and let it slow cook for 1 hour. 5. Serve with local chutney.
description: A primal, slow-cooked celebration of the earth, buried in a clay pot.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
